Despite its gentle nature, it's incredibly effective at dissolving every trace of makeup, dirt, and daily grime - even stubborn mascara and sunscreen are no match. The real magic happens after rinsing. Theres no tight, dry, or "stripped" feeling that many cleansers cause. Instead, my skin feels instantly, velvet-soft and looks radiant.

avis.titre: I think I'm Allergic to This One
avis.texte: Pro: Absorbs in quickly, completely. Leaves a silky feel. Rich, so a little goes a long way. Very faint fragrance. Con: Hands down, I'm convinced my skin is allergic to whatever is in this product. I have normal skin, never had any sensitivity issues before. I can't recommend this product. Instead, I use the Dream Night Cream (love it) and I've ordered the Seabiotic Water Cream to try.

Super disappointed in this one. I used to use Osea's Ocean Cleanser Purifying Face Wash and it worked well. My face was clean yet soft after using it and the smell was wonderful. I thought I'd give this Cleansing Milk a try and to my dismay, it leaves makeup on my face even after cleansing twice (I dry my face with a white towel...). The whole point of a cleanser, in my opinion, is to wash it all off on the first try. I'm sorely disappointed in spending so much for getting a glorified "cleanser". The smell isn't particularly great either. The other one did really smell like a spa experience, with notes of citrus. This, I don't even know what it is, but it's trash. Honestly wish I could get my money back, but I feel bad bringing it back after having tried it for a couple days as I'm sure it'd be tossed. I'd avoid purchasing this one if you want a fully clean face.
It feels luxurious and like I'm pampering myself. Plus knowing that it's natural and non-toxic makes me feel even better about how I'm treating my skin.
